prompt: Create ONE production cutout animation PARTS ATLAS for the supplied original VALHEM Viking veteran. Premium crisp painterly gritty Norse game materials, adult muscular anatomy, clean strong readable silhouettes at small size, matching palette across all parts. NO assembled character, NO sword/shield/weapon, NO floor, NO shadow, NO decorative frame, NO smoke/glow. This is a functional modular sprite atlas for skeletal animation, not a concept sheet.
